snow_long_shared_roles_2026_10_20.design: One authored world x 23 frozen conditions: 11 matched role/interface/source controls and 12 predeclared whole-schema removals. Same FD 26.6 lama-first, 20-second wall/CPU configuration, 4096 MB, one worker.
snow_long_shared_roles_2026_10_20.primary: 12-step independently validated plan at 8.172 observed seconds: 4 contextualized source steps and 8 new scenario steps; 13 states pass role identity, alive/dead exclusion, unique canonical scene position and unique comb custody checks.
snow_long_shared_roles_2026_10_20.necessity: Deleting any one returned step makes the remainder inapplicable or the final goal false (12/12); removing each of the 12 declared backbone action schemas also reports unsolvable (12/12). Irredundancy is conditional on this scenario; no general shortest-plan theorem is claimed.
snow_long_shared_roles_2026_10_20.semantic_counterexample: Without the life adapter, a 12-step valid goal plan still has simultaneous alive/dead in states 9, 10 and 11 and fails the scenario contract.

snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.design: One authored world, eleven conditions, all frozen before search; Fast Downward 26.6 lama-first, 20-second wall/CPU, 4096 MB, one worker. All 56 source templates compiled before explicit role permissions and removal controls.
snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.identity: One request object q__snow_white fills SNOW victim, SNOW witch and JACK giant slots; explicit static roles and three source entity memberships. Original source constants remain distinct.
snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.primary_result: 4-step plan uses HANS_NP once, JACK_NP once and SNOW twice; 7.734 observed seconds including launch/response; independent plan validation and five-state role/life checks pass.
snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.controls: No interfaces, no possession interface, no death interface, each of three single-source-action controls, removal of HANS_NP and removal of shared memberships all report unsolvable. Unrestricted role/life baseline hits its 20-second limit.
snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.negative_semantic_control: Without the life adapter, a 4-step plan is formally valid but Snow White is alive and dead in two intermediate states and casts a spell after death. It fails the declared scenario contract and is not counted as story success.
modifications: Static role permissions on every action parameter; uncast roles have no allowed binding

snow_shared_roles_2026_10_20.supported_scope: Executable shared-identity cross-source composition under the declared authored scenario contract; not unrestricted source preservation or automatic semantic alignment.

acco_birt_bridge_2026_10_20.results: Authored possession interface with both sources: validated 4-step plan, 8.594 observed seconds including WSL launch/response. No interface, ACCO-actions-only, BIRT-actions-only and no-shared-identity conditions: solver-reported unsolvable.

Selector retains both sources in this world.

selection_bottleneck_2026_10_20.design: 30 fresh sequential solver calls, 15 unchanged original worlds x graph-closure control and static-source-universe selection; 20 seconds wall/CPU, 4096 MB, one worker; older full-pool results separately labeled
selection_bottleneck_2026_10_20.CHIC_NP: Graph-closure control hit its limit at 20.094 observed seconds; selected condition returned a validated 40-step plan at 1.421 observed seconds. Instrumented translator diagnostics counted 292117 versus 371 grounded actions; 291746 of the former belong to HANS_NP.
selection_bottleneck_2026_10_20.mechanism: Whole-source selection by interface connectivity over-selects HANS_NP despite disjoint static source universes. Large typed parameter products, unused parameters and an unconditional action generate substantial independent grounding/SAS conversion work.
selection_bottleneck_2026_10_20.preservation_check: 4 available original-goal plans pass in selected models; all 15 source rows retained; 64 states, 23457 source-atom comparisons, zero mismatches
limitations: All selected models are singletons in these original worlds; cross-source narrative fusion is not demonstrated
HANS_NP, MUSI and SNOW still hit limits
No independent semantic labels or narrative assessments
One fixed-order development comparison; no statistical speedup claim
Instrumented diagnostics are separate and preserve failed first attempts; no extra solver success units
selection_bottleneck_2026_10_20.test_checkpoint: 175 tests passed in 68.039 seconds; dated engineering validation
